newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Hospital buys Sydney hospital.
newsitem.headline: Australia Hospital buys Sydney hospital.

text.p: Private hospital operator Australian Hospital Care (AHX) Ltd said on Thursday it had bought the Lady Davidson Hospital in Sydney's North Shore from the Department of Veteran's Affairs (DVA).
"The sale to AHX comes with a 10 year contract with the DVA for the continued treatment of veterans in this 120 bed, specialist rehabilitation and palliative care facility," AHX said.

The hospital, which operated at close to 90 percent occupancy levels, would undergo a significant upgrade and would contribute to the group's performance for nine months of the year to June 30 1998 year, AHX said.
"AHX sees Lady Davidson as the company's first acquisition in New South Wales and is looking closely at this state as part of the overall growth strategy," it said.
AHX did not specify the acquisition price or the hospital's financial details and a spokesman was not immediately available for comment.
This acquisition bought AHX's portfolio to 18 hospitals, mostly on the eastern coast of Australia.
Australian Hospital's shares were down three cents at A$2.28 at 11.15 a.m. (0115 GMT).
